records.name: World Economic Forum Annual Meeting
records.targetAudience: Government and Business Leaders, Policymakers, Academics
records.description: The World Economic Forum Annual Meeting in Davos is the premier global agenda-setting event, bringing together thousands of leaders from government, business, and civil society to address pressing global challenges and shape policy for the year ahead, often with a significant focus on technology's impact on economics and society.

records.name: 148th SICTIC Investor Day
records.description: A high-intensity matchmaking event where pre-vetted Swiss startups pitch for immediate seed and early-stage funding.

records.name: Alpine Robo Games
records.description: A high-energy robotics competition event, the Alpine Robo Games features intense VEX V5 and VEX IQ championships, encouraging young students to develop skills in engineering, coding, and teamwork by designing, building, and programming their own robots to compete in various challenges.

records.name: Applied Machine Learning Days
records.targetAudience: AI Researchers, Data Scientists, Industry Practitioners
records.description: Hosted at EPFL, the Applied Machine Learning Days is recognized as Europe's largest conference focused on the practical application of AI and Machine Learning, featuring deep-dive workshops, keynote speeches from global experts, and showcases of cutting-edge research and industrial solutions across various sectors.

records.name: International Humanoid Forum
records.description: A specialized industry forum focused on the practical integration of humanoid robotics into manufacturing and logistics.

records.name: FINANZ'26
records.description: The leading B2B trade show for the Swiss financial industry, focusing on professional investing and emerging fintech.

records.name: Web3 Banking Symposium
records.description: A focused symposium bridging the gap between traditional banking and decentralized finance (DeFi), featuring technical deep-dives on custody, stablecoins, and regulatory compliance for Swiss financial institutions.

records.name: Swiss Semiconductor Day 2026
records.description: Full-day event dedicated to Switzerland’s activities in the semiconductor field, bringing together leading representatives from public institutions, research organizations, and private companies. This unique event will provide an in-depth view of Switzerland’s role within the global semiconductor value chain — from chip design to metrology and advanced packaging. Participants will share first-hand insights into their organizations’ strategies, innovations, and perspectives on the current challenges and opportunities shaping the industry.

records.name: START Summit
records.description: Organized entirely by students, START Summit has grown into Europe's leading conference for entrepreneurship and technology, connecting ambitious student founders with prominent investors, major corporations, and media figures in an energetic environment designed to spark new ventures and facilitate high-level networking.

records.name: GenAI Zürich
records.targetAudience: Enterprise Executives, AI Strategists, Data Leaders
records.description: A targeted B2B summit focused entirely on the implementation and strategic use of Generative AI within the enterprise environment, providing deep insights into practical applications, governance, ethical considerations, and the creation of business value using large language and image models.

records.name: BEA: Robotics in Everyday Life
records.description: Part of the massive annual BEA trade fair, this specific showcase section highlights consumer-facing robotics and automation technologies, demonstrating how robots and intelligent systems are becoming integrated into homes, services, and daily activities for the general public.

records.name: HealthTech Startup Roadshow
records.description: An exclusive roadshow designed to connect high-potential international healthtech startups with the Greater Zurich Area's life sciences ecosystem, including visits to Roche, Novartis, and university labs.

records.name: Cairo Global Zurich
records.description: The inaugural Crypto, AI, and Robotics Conference brings together pioneers at the frontier of intelligent machines, decentralised systems, and real-world human-machine collaboration. More than an event, it is a launchpad for a community platform at the intersection of three technologies shaping tomorrow.

records.name: Swiss Biotech Day
records.description: The premier annual conference for the Swiss biotechnology industry, this event facilitates networking and collaboration between Swiss and international biotech companies, investors, and academia, focusing on R&D breakthroughs, financing, and market trends in the life sciences sector.

records.name: Global Innovation Summit
records.targetAudience: Research promotion organizations and industrial partners
records.description: Organized by Innosuisse to foster international cooperation in biotech, digitalization, and industrial manufacturing.

records.name: Startup Days (SUD)
records.description: Serving as the national networking event for the Swiss startup ecosystem, Startup Days provides a crucial platform for early-stage companies to pitch their ideas, connect with experienced mentors, secure funding, and engage with established Swiss businesses looking for innovation partners.

records.name: Crypto Valley Conference
records.description: The flagship event for Switzerland's Crypto Valley, this conference focuses on advanced topics in blockchain technology, decentralized finance (DeFi), NFTs, and often features discussions on next-generation hardware and decentralized physical infrastructure networks (DePIN).

records.name:
ELROB 2026
European Land Robot Trial
records.description: The European Land Robot Trial is a pure outdoor robotics trial for defense and security applications, focusing on real-world capabilities in rough terrain, EOD (explosive disposal), and autonomous logistics.

records.name: Swiss Fintech Week
records.targetAudience: Fintech Founders, Bankers, Regulators, Tech Providers
records.description: A multi-day series of specialized events, workshops, and gatherings across Zurich, Swiss Fintech Week connects the finance and technology communities, providing a platform to discuss regulatory sandboxes, digital assets, open banking, and the future of financial services.

records.name: Point Zero Forum
records.description: A high-level dialogue between Swiss and Singaporean regulators focused on digital asset policy and fintech governance.

records.name: Davos Tech Summit
records.targetAudience: AI Researchers, Roboticists, Tech Ethics Leaders
records.description: Focused on "Touching Intelligence," this summit explores the convergence of Physical AI and robotics, discussing how embodied intelligence will reshape labor, healthcare, and daily life.

records.name: AI for Good Global Summit
records.targetAudience: UN Officials, AI Researchers, NGOs, Government Representatives
records.description: The leading UN-driven platform that promotes AI as a means to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), gathering international experts to discuss ethical guidelines, showcase impactful AI solutions for global challenges, and facilitate partnerships between AI developers and those in need.

records.name: All About Automation Zürich
records.description: A focused trade fair for industrial automation in the Zurich region, providing a platform for component manufacturers, distributors, and service providers to meet with local machine builders and operators.

records.name: Digital Day Switzerland
records.description: A nationwide initiative aiming to promote digital inclusion and raise awareness about the opportunities and challenges of digitalization and technology adoption across Swiss society, involving workshops, discussions, and events in major cities like Zurich, Geneva, and Lugano to bridge the gap between technology and the public.

records.name: Swiss Green Economy Symposium (SGES)
records.targetAudience: Sustainability Managers, Green Tech Investors, Policymakers
records.description: An important conference dedicated to fostering a sustainable business environment, focusing on green technologies, circular economy solutions, and the financial and technological innovations required to transition Swiss businesses toward environmentally responsible practices.

records.name: Top100 Swiss Investor Summit & Startup Award 2026
records.description: A highly curated, invitation-only forum convening domestic and international venture capitalists to evaluate the top 100 deep-tech, biotech, and engineering ventures in the nation.

records.name: Digitalswitzerland Forum 2026
records.description: A high-level assembly tasked with formulating the Swiss AI Action Plan and establishing smart governance frameworks in preparation for the 2027 Geneva Summit.

records.name: TechBio Day 2026
records.description: Illustrates a paradigm shift from reactive diagnostics to predictive, continuous on-body intelligence, focusing on clinical-grade wearables and multi-omics.

records.name: Tage der Technik
records.description: Details Switzerland's role as a critical supplier of high-precision aerospace components, autonomous satellite systems, and deep-space robotics.

records.name: #wetechtogether Conference 2026
records.description: Tackles the structural diversity of the technology workforce, providing high-level technical workshops alongside strategic leadership seminars.

records.name: Zurich AI Festival
records.description: A city-wide celebration of Artificial Intelligence featuring open labs, public debates, art installations, and hackathons, designed to demystify AI and engage the broader public in the conversation.

records.name: Swiss {ai} Weeks
records.description: Swiss AI Weeks is a large-scale national movement that calls on researchers, developers, businesses, and citizens to collaborate on the future of AI, with a strong focus on ethical and open solutions. The event spans over a month, featuring numerous hackathons, workshops, and learning events across multiple cities in Switzerland, aiming to build a human-centered AI ecosystem.

records.name: CV Summit
records.description: A major gathering for the Crypto Valley ecosystem, the CV Summit focuses on investment trends, institutional adoption of blockchain, regulatory clarity, and the growth of decentralized organizations within the Swiss financial landscape.

records.name: China/Asia High-Tech meets Switzerland
records.description: AI is leaving the screen. And entering the real world. Factories. Robots. Energy systems. Infrastructure. Asia is deploying AI at scale. Europe is still evaluating. This event brings both sides together

records.name: AI + X Summit
records.description: The flagship event of the ETH AI Center, showcasing the latest research breakthroughs and fostering collaboration between academia and industry across sectors like healthcare, finance, and engineering.

records.name: Luxury Innovation Summit
records.description: The world's premier event for the luxury tech sector, exploring how blockchain, AI, and sustainability tech are transforming the fashion, watchmaking, and high-end retail industries.

records.name: The Zurich AI Summit 2026
records.description: The Zurich AI Summit 2026 brings together 250 of Switzerland's AI and Business Leaders, for an evening of content and networking

records.name: Startup Nights
records.description: A hands-on, community-focused conference designed to connect innovative startups with established Swiss Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs), emphasizing practical workshops, networking, and direct collaboration to accelerate digital projects and foster regional innovation.

records.name: Swiss Robotics Day
records.description: Switzerland's primary exhibition and conference dedicated to the commercial robotics sector, focusing on the industrial deployment of robotic solutions, automation advancements, and the transition of cutting-edge research into market-ready applications.

records.name: Swiss AI Summit
records.targetAudience: AI experts, business leaders, and investors
records.description: The Swiss AI Summit is a premier international platform in Zurich, ZH, for fostering collaboration and innovation in artificial intelligence. It features keynotes, panel discussions, and high-level networking opportunities, focusing on the latest AI trends, ethical considerations, and practical business applications to drive the future of the Swiss AI ecosystem.

sourceVariants.name: Swiss AI Summit
sourceVariants.description: A rigorous platform dedicated to the enterprise execution of artificial intelligence, solving scaling challenges across finance, manufacturing, and healthcare.

records.name: Kickstart Innovation Closing Ceremony
records.description: The graduation ceremony for Switzerland's premier corporate-startup bridge, announcing pilot deals and partnerships.

records.name: EPFL Investor Day
records.description: EPFL Investor Day connects top investors with breakthrough deeptech startups, fueling innovation and global entrepreneurship from the heart of Switzerland.

records.name: Open-i / Swiss Tech Award
records.description: Switzerland's paramount innovation platform exploring Defense, Space, Energy, and AI, acting as a bridge between university tech transfer and industry.
